verdict.rationale: Pigment documents scheduled imports and native connectors that bring fresh data into an existing model, and variance analysis on the same platform as the budget. Together these imply actuals can flow into the live model without rebuilding it. Nothing in the pack shows the forecast itself re-baselining or rolling forward on new actuals after a close. missing for 10: documented forecast re-baselining or rolling-forecast logic on actuals, a close-cycle actuals refresh workflow, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the forecast re-baselines on fresh actuals after each close without rebuilding the model

citations.quote: easily integrated through native connectors, open APIs, and scheduled imports.
Run variance analysis on the same platform you build your budget.
